title: Accept standalone hosted setup against the deployed build
text: Partly closed: retained CI founding screenshots and the prototype source-render refresh have accepted evidence. The refreshed beta and organization screens cover desktop/phone in both themes, named refusals, aligned URL/Subscription rows and one creation indicator with slow-state wording. The refresh was explicitly accepted as rendering shipped components, not a real founding transaction. Timed real stage founding and production screen inspection remain open; a source render does not close those live obligations.
evidence: Review on 2026-11-05: the producer records passing CI with the founding-proof screenshot matrix. Registered prototype-refresh requirement 43259 has passing QA run 47166 and independent review of artifacts 33376 and 33377.
